{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes RPC utility error reporting in src/rpc/util.cpp and modifies RPC error responses for descriptor methods to avoid echoing secret keys.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents exposure of sensitive key material via RPC error replies that can be captured in application logs or shared bug reports. The PR description notes that error messages currently 'quote the raw input strings directly, exposing private keys to application logs, exception reporters, or support screenshots', directly addressing RPC interface data exposure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/util/bip32.cpp with two lines as a mechanical consequence of descriptor error handling rather than changing shared utility infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The minor tweak in bip32 utility code is incidental to descriptor and wallet error sanitization."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies error handling during descriptor imports and transaction funding in src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Stops leaking private keys (WIF, xprvs) in error messages when importing descriptors or funding transactions. The author notes that 'a descriptor can hold a private key' and 'the reply then carries the key into places the request may not go', safeguarding key confidentiality during wallet failures."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
